items.scope: Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
Digi branded products and services only.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Johnson Controls products only.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Cloudflare products, projects hosted at https://github.com/cloudflare/, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Cloudflare that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Zscaler issues only.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Gallagher security products only.
GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
PaperCut MF, PaperCut NG, PaperCut Hive, PaperCut Pocket, PaperCut Mobility Print, QRdoc, PaperCut Views, PaperCut Multiverse, https://www.papercut.com, and all other PaperCut products and services.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Citrix issues only.
Adobe issues only.
NVIDIA issues only.
All NortonLifeLock product issues only.
All vulnerabilities on software products that our company provides, including KNIME Analytics Platform, KNIME Server, and KNIME Hub.
All Armis products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Armis that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Crafter CMS issues only.
Software vulnerabilities related to the TianoCore Open Source.
All Esri products only, including ArcGIS.
Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Cryptographic issues found in wolfSSL products.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
Sophos issues only.
ASR products only.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.
Dragos products and third-party products it researches related to operational technology (OT)/industrial control systems (ICS) not covered by another CNA.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.

All F5 products and services, commercial and open source, which have not yet reached End of Technical Support (EoTS). All legacy acquisition products and brands including, but not limited to, NGINX, Shape Security, Volterra, and Threat Stack. F5 does not issue CVEs for products which are no longer supported.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
Microchip Technology products only.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.

All Cisco products, and any third-party research targets that are not in another CNA’s scope. Cisco will not issue a CVE ID for issues reported on products that are past the Last Day of Support milestone, as defined on Cisco’s End-of-Life Policy, which is available at https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/eos-eol-policy.html.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
Juniper issues only.
Switzerland Government Common Vulnerability Program.

Vulnerabilities in open source projects affecting the Fedora Project, that are not covered by a more specific CNA. CVEs can be assigned to vulnerabilities affecting end-of-life or unsupported releases by the Fedora Project.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HCL products only.
MongoDB products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
Azure Access branded products and technologies only.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
